sorted_merge_join.comment: End-to-end tests for the streaming sorted merge join (join_strategy='sorted'). The table is partitioned on the join key so the planner inserts a hash-distributed, sorted exchange on each join input; the SortedMergeJoinOperator then advances both inputs with a two-pointer merge instead of building a hash table. Results are validated against H2. Only the V1 (logical) path is wired for sorted-input routing today, so the V2 physical optimizer is skipped via ignoreV2Optimizer.

queries.description: Inner sorted merge self-join on the partitioned/sorted join key (one-to-many runs per key)
queries.sql: SELECT /*+ joinOptions(join_strategy='sorted') */ a.correlation_id, a.event, b.event FROM {user_events} a JOIN {user_events} b ON a.correlation_id = b.correlation_id
queries.h2Sql: SELECT a.correlation_id, a.event, b.event FROM {user_events} a JOIN {user_events} b ON a.correlation_id = b.correlation_id

queries.description: Count of joined rows via sorted merge join
queries.sql: SELECT /*+ joinOptions(join_strategy='sorted') */ COUNT(*) FROM {user_events} a JOIN {user_events} b ON a.correlation_id = b.correlation_id
queries.h2Sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {user_events} a JOIN {user_events} b ON a.correlation_id = b.correlation_id

queries.description: Funnel-style self-join: count correlation_ids that have both a checkout and an addToCart event
queries.sql: SELECT /*+ joinOptions(join_strategy='sorted') */ COUNT(*) FROM {user_events} a JOIN {user_events} b ON a.correlation_id = b.correlation_id WHERE a.event = 'checkout' AND b.event = 'addToCart'
queries.h2Sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {user_events} a JOIN {user_events} b ON a.correlation_id = b.correlation_id WHERE a.event = 'checkout' AND b.event = 'addToCart'

queries.description: Left sorted merge join with a non-equi residual condition on the right side (unmatched left rows padded with null)
queries.sql: SELECT /*+ joinOptions(join_strategy='sorted') */ a.correlation_id, a.event, b.event FROM {user_events} a LEFT JOIN {user_events} b ON a.correlation_id = b.correlation_id AND b.event = 'checkout'
queries.h2Sql: SELECT a.correlation_id, a.event, b.event FROM {user_events} a LEFT JOIN {user_events} b ON a.correlation_id = b.correlation_id AND b.event = 'checkout'

queries.description: Aggregation above a sorted merge join
queries.sql: SELECT /*+ joinOptions(join_strategy='sorted') */ a.correlation_id, COUNT(*) FROM {user_events} a JOIN {user_events} b ON a.correlation_id = b.correlation_id GROUP BY a.correlation_id
queries.h2Sql: SELECT a.correlation_id, COUNT(*) FROM {user_events} a JOIN {user_events} b ON a.correlation_id = b.correlation_id GROUP BY a.correlation_id
